verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for an observability platform that stores telemetry, so the axis applies. The pack never documents retention periods, lifecycle policies, or deletion controls. The closest items are adjacent: time series data streams that 'keep storage costs predictable' and configuring the logs@custom component template, and neither states that users can set retention or delete data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
